Package tasktracker.view.components

Reusable Swing controls and their interaction behavior. These controls do not access task storage.
  • Class Summary 
    Class Description
    AccountMenuButton
    Compact account menu using the scene picker's reversible popover motion.
    AppearanceControl
    Animated Swing appearance switch, separate from dashboard logic.
    CalendarPanel
    Dependency-free month calendar.
    DatePickerField
    Calendar popover hosted inside the existing window, never a dialog.
    FluidScrollPane
    Direct precision scrolling; only the edge return is animated.
    PressFeedbackButton
    Shared primary and text actions with gentle press feedback and keyboard focus.
    PriorityPicker
    Labeled, keyboard-accessible priority choices with redundant color and check cues.
    SceneComboBox<E>
    Scene-tinted selection control retaining Swing's selection and keyboard behavior.
    SceneFields
    Standard editable Swing fields with live scene tints and consistent focus edges.
